versions.content: If the BswMDevErrorDetect switch is enabled, the parameter requesting_user shall be checked for being in the allowed range. In case of an error, the BswM shall ignore the mode request and report the error to the Default Error Tracer with the value BSWM_E_REQ_USER_OUT_OF_RANGE.
